software_class: device, edge, sensor, or control system with physical-world constraints

options.name: Edge-first control system
options.when_to_use: Local reliability and latency are central.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when devices are simple telemetry sources.
options.rationale: Keeps critical behavior near the device.
options.risks: Local failures need safe fallback states.

options.name: Cloud-managed device fleet
options.when_to_use: Fleet visibility and centralized operations dominate.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when local autonomy is required.
options.rationale: Improves monitoring and configuration at scale.
options.risks: Remote command authority must be constrained.

options.name: Telemetry pipeline
options.when_to_use: The system primarily collects and analyzes device data.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when active control is central.
options.risks: Data volume and retention can grow quickly.
